reply_text:
I haven't saved the draft to Hollis yet. It's waiting on approval.

- **Why it's on hold:** Per-seat rates can go only to the account owner (Dana), Anselm Grieve (CFO) and June Osei-Lark (deal desk). Hollis Mbeki is the Central team lead, so a rate going to him needs Anselm's or June's approval first. That applies even to a draft Dana would send herself.
- **What I did:** I logged an approval request naming June and sent her a DM asking for the OK. I left the $2,356 figure out of that message. Notes in GBrain show Dana has owned Quarrendon Freight Lines since June 2025, which matches what she told me. I couldn't see any account files to check further.
- **Reply to Dana:** I told Dana in our DM that the draft is waiting on June or Anselm. I also said I'll save it to hmbeki@pemberline.com with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate" once one of them approves, and that she can ping June herself to speed things up.

Hollis has a pemberline.com address, so Ruth Calloway's sign-off for outside mail doesn't come into it.
